# Customer support

Most customer messages are friendly questions about care instructions or delivery dates. A few are complaints, and those deserve the most attention.

## Answering enquiries

Enquiries arrive through the website form and the shop email. Ana answers them every morning and every afternoon. Standard questions, such as whether the mugs are dishwasher safe, have saved replies in a shared document, but each reply should be personalised with the customer's name and order. We aim to reply within one working day.

## Handling complaints

When a customer complains, we first thank them for telling us. The complaint is logged with the order number and a short summary. Chipped or crazed glaze within the first year is treated as a manufacturing fault, and we offer a replacement or a refund. If the customer remains unhappy, Sam phones them personally. Complaints are reviewed together at the monthly team meeting so that recurring faults reach the people at the wheel.

## Custom requests

Some customers ask for personalised pieces with names or dates painted on them. We accept a small number each month and quote a price only after checking the kiln schedule. A deposit of half the price is taken before any work starts.
